1.body:
Hello,

I saw your opening for a UI/UX Designer and wanted to connect, especially since Trovex is building an AI-powered platform to help sales teams practice conversations and improve through intelligent coaching.

At AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and fed those findings directly back into user flows and interface usability, while also building visual identity systems and brand guidelines for early-stage startups.

My B2B UX case study, Bounceless, demonstrates structured problem-solving for a cleaner verification experience on teams that depend on accurate email lists, which you can see at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Could I share a quick walkthrough of how I approach interface design and workflow simplification for products like yours next week?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/
